data.one_liner: A simple wrapper for posting messages to Slack using Incoming Webhooks.
data.what_it_does: Allows posting messages, layout blocks, and attachments to Slack channels or direct messages via Incoming Webhooks. Supports rich formatting, block kit components, and custom bot configurations.
use_when: You need to send server notifications or app updates to a Slack channel
You want to use Slack's Block Kit to create interactive or visually rich messages from Dart/Flutter
avoid_when: You need to receive real-time messages from Slack in a bidirectional chat interface
You require full OAuth bot setup beyond simple incoming webhooks
strengths: Easy to setup and use with a single webhook URL
Supports comprehensive Slack Block Kit elements and attachments
Works across multiple platforms including Flutter Web
weaknesses: Limited strictly to sending messages via Incoming Webhooks
No built-in support for reading incoming chat messages or advanced bot events
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a Slack app and enabling Incoming Webhooks to obtain a webhook URL.
